how: Matched to the S-21-46 20 um crop (real_stats_S2146.json, 'bright' = above the whole-brain threshold 142.5; real_cl_S2146.json for the orientation statistics). Noise: white N(0, 95.7) blurred by a Gaussian of 1.1 voxels; its DoG bands 4.6/2.9/1.2/0.4 against the real noise bands (10% smoothest blocks) 3.9/2.1/1.1/0.8. Texture: fibres at 120/mm^2, widths sigma 1/2/3/6 voxels (p 0.45/0.3/0.15/0.1), darkening 100 grey levels at the 99th percentile of density, each fibre's direction dispersed about the population mean by 20 deg (in-plane SD) and 10 deg (out of plane). This is the COHERENT-BUNDLE baseline (t = 1): DoG texture bands about 3.3/3.0/2.3/1.7 against the real 4.2/2.9/2.1/2.1, structure-tensor orientation gap (l2-l3)/l2 about 0.64 at rho 8-32. The real crop's gap median is 0.25-0.30 (10th percentile 0.11, 90th 0.49) and its Westin cl median 0.11-0.13 (phantom 0.03): the real tissue is less coherent and more interface-rich than any homogeneous fibre model; a 30 deg dispersion at 0.6x amplitude reproduces the gap median (0.32) but halves the texture bands (calib_dispersion.json). So the suite sweeps the texture amplitude (t = 1, 0.5, 0.25, 0.1) and reports where the real median lies: between the t0.25 and t0.5 phantoms by the gap, with its 10th percentile near t0.1.
